authorization: 2026-10-22 用户要求本次由 Codex 制作，不使用 Opus。
design: 项目设计：同一伤位的发面擦损、压痕、焦痕、旧疤及断发—面皮—普通馅—中央中枢分层。

hair_response.dent: skin and covering hair indent together, no cutout
hair_response.scorch: local char, retain closed hair surface
hair_response.tear: break strands only inside opening; removed fragments vanish, no loose hair
hair_response.core: break hair only along real open tissue loss; no loose hair

coordinates: Model units; central core stays at core_center. Local U is tangent, V is up, N points outward. Decal UV: u=(U/radiusU+1)/2, v=(1-V/radiusV)/2. No screen-space placement.
boundary: Authored meshes and textures only. Runtime hair clipping, bone binding and wound-state selection are not connected by this package. Independent ornaments and hanging braids are excluded.
